summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py (thread-entry state set/cleared in run_app's try/finally; not-running and same-thread RuntimeErrors; scheduling via run_coroutine_threadsafe with active_app set and invoke used on a partial-bound callable). Added tests/test_concurrency.py with 9 tests; all pass when PYTHONPATH points at the generated src (the venv's textual otherwise resolves to base/). Unrelated pre-existing failures: 8 async-def tests in other modules fail because the venv lacks an async pytest plugin. Nothing committed.
